elements.name: Saturn
elements.text: Saturn: structure and discipline, the boundary that closes one cycle so another can begin.

elements.name: Encircling wreath
elements.text: The wreath of green fronds surrounding her: a whole made complete, the circle closed at journey's end.

elements.name: Star-scarves
elements.text: The starry cloth draped across her hands: the boundary between worlds, held loosely and ready to be released.

rounds.text: The journey that began with the Fool completes here. Saturn, the planet that sets boundaries and cuts away the {b1}, governs this final card, often shown with a wreath {b2} wholeness and a closed circle. From the World, all that's left is to begin again, staying open rather than settling into comfort. Saturn closes this cycle cleanly, clearing the way for the next one to start.
